v: Haa... ee movie gurinchi ఎంత రాసినా emotion complete ga cheppalenu 🙏 Mahanati pulled me into that era and Keerthy + Dulquer simply LIVED those roles. EPIC.
e: Mahanati succeeds with every kind of viewer I could imagine: people who lived through Savitri’s aura, later generations who knew the legend from family and films, and complete newcomers simply looking for a cinematic experience. Nag Ashwin’s narrative, the period craft, Samantha’s climax and astonishing lead performances make it a wonderful, deeply emotional experience.
body:
to start with…..the audience for this movie can be classified into 3 types:

1. The old old age ppl, who lived during the aura of Savitri and are keen to see how the current generation has show cased her aura on screen

2. The next category is the old aged ppl…who though may have not lived through the aura, may have known little about her (jst like the current kids known about Chiru) and are keen to see her story

3. The last group who may have no idea who the hell Savitri is and are least bothered to know about her aura….but came to theater just for a cinematic experience

and the beauty of this EPIC is all the above 3 types of audience get glued to the movie withine first 20 mins and leave the auditorium with heart full of emotions!!!

The first 2 types of audience will find the Biopic a great tribute to the legendary actress, whereas the the 3 type of audience will find the movie similar to the lines of Madhur Bhandarkar’s Fashion set in the Movue backdrop and 1960’s aura……irrespective of your perspective of watching the movie, you will surely get involved till the rolling titles and the 3 hrs long movie never feel like Long!!!!

The Director, Cinematographer and the Dialogue writer and BGM composer have made sure that the audience get lost in the beauty of the Black n White era…….

Rather than narrating the biography in a simple and straight manner, the director has cleverly mixed it with the story of a Journalist shows his brilliance _/\_ The first 10 mins itself gives the audience a clue about what they are goining to witness in the next 2.5 hrs and the Climax with superb dialogues and Samantha’s performance is simply a standout _/\_ _/\_ _/\_

Keerthy suresh and Dulquer Salmaan just lived in the chars of Savitri and Gemini Ganeshan!!!!

haa…….could keep on writing on this movie, but cannot 100% put the emotions I have gone through while watching it……Thanks Nag Ashwin for the wonderful experience, you have dreamt about this Biopic and made it Big….Very Very Big!!!

v: Father wants to send his 75-year-old son to an old-age home 😂 Premise itself enough! Amitabh + Rishi give laughs, emotion and a lovely message without turning it into a tear-fest.
e: 102 Not Out proves that strong writing and execution can do wonders without a huge canvas. Amitabh Bachchan and Rishi Kapoor are effortless, but the real stars are Umesh Shukla and writer Saumya Joshi, who turn a potentially heart-wrenching three-character story into a warm, funny and emotionally lasting experience.
body:
Amitabh and Rishi Kapoor are in that phase of career where they can select the scripts which emotionally move them or challange their acting capabilities without worrying about the so called fans or box office results!!!! and here we go they have worked on a subject which lasts an emotional impact on the audience.

The script doesnt challange the acting capabilities of the 2 legends at any point of time…..but its the content and execution which keeps the audience glued to the screen. common we was the last time we came across the story which is atleast 50% emotional or meaningful as the one where a Father wanting to Join his Son in a Old Age Home!!!! _/\_

given the nature of the story, one could expect the movie to be a Heartwrenching emotional ride…..but what we get is 1 hr 40 mins of geninue laughs with under current emotion and message _/\_

the stiry has mainly 3 chars and these are the kind of stories which creats an intrest in the writer and director the film rather than the star cast…..and its Umesh Shukla the director and Saumya Joshi the writer….kudos 2 both of u for making us believe that superb content with low budget can do wonders

v: Leader ni full commercial BLOCKBUSTER package lo cook chesthe Bharath Ane Nenu 😄 Freshness meeda doubts unna, Mahesh + dialogues + DSP + elevations totally work.
e: Bharath Ane Nenu did not win me over through originality; I felt Koratala Siva was drawing heavily from the political climate and films such as Leader. But he packages those familiar ideas extremely well, blending commercial hero elevations into the story, giving Mahesh Babu one of his strongest recent vehicles and tapping directly into audience frustration with politics and TRP-driven media.
body:
to start with, I was never a fan of Koritala Shiva’s stories as I somehow feel that he gets inspired from whats happening around him and then completely fills with commercial elements…..like Srimanthudu was directly lifted from Modi’s Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana and added few high octane commercial scenes

for Janatha Garage, he got inspired from Telangana govt’s Haritha Haram project and designed Hero’s charachter who loves tree’s and the story is inspired from many of RGV’s old fomula of Sarkar series!!!

Now coming to Bharath Ane Nenu……he got inspired from the polictical environment in the country and state, then watched LEADER movie and bingo he got his story readymade!!!! (only my point of view though)

as the story is readily available, he completely focuses on ensuring that commericial ingrediants and Hero elevation scenes are perfectly added and followed the same elevation templates of Srimanthudu and Janata Gaurage, which effortlessly blend into the story!!!! and there we go we have a Blockbuster ready!!!!

its obviously the best movie Mahesh had in the recent past…..and we the audience instantly get connected to the movie as we were vexed up with the real current political scenario and how the media is behind trp’s!!!

the movie has some of the best dialogues in recent times and Mahesh performance is as usually intense and DSP’s music is again as usually terrific!!!

In one sentance…BharathAneNenu is a commercialised and Blockbuster version of LEADER!!!

v: 3 hours ante patience kavali 😄 But Charan, Samantha, Aadhi, Jagapathi Babu + that beautiful 80s Godavari world made Rangasthalam worth it for me. Charan finally shows the ACTOR 🙏
e: Rangasthalam is less about Sukumar showing off clever narrative tricks and more about performances and world-building. The long runtime may test some viewers, but the cast is excellent, the 1980s Godavari village is beautifully realised, DSP’s BGM and meaningful songs add enormous flavour, and Ram Charan finally gets to show the actor inside the star.
body:
the movie will disappoint you, if you are big fan of Sukumar’s intelligent direction. movie will disappoint you, if you are impatient to watch a movie which has a runtime close to 3 hrs.

on contrary, you will love the movie to the core if you watch it for Charan, Samantha, Aadhi, Jagapathi Babu & Naresh’s EXCELLENT performances. you will love the movie for the EXCELLENT potryal of the 1980’s Godari village. DSP’s BGM is as usual terrific and the music with perfect and meaningful lyrics add value. spl shout out to “Aa gatununtava” song which had great lyrics and somehow missed in the Hit list and was supressed by other 2 chartbusters

Finally after a Decade in films, Charan has finally showed audience his acting capeabilities, which will make the Actor Chiru (not the megastar or best dancer of TFI) proud!!! Hope he continues similar kind of script selection
